title: Grateful Dead Live at Academy of Music on 1972-03-23

ai_review.summary: Stellar soundboard capture of a peak‑Dead performance with standout Jack Straw and flawless audio.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about this SBD, calling the audio "great" and "so good," while celebrating the show as a peak moment for the Dead, especially highlighting the Jack Straw performance. The recording is praised as clear and enjoyable with no noted flaws.

ai_rating.rationale: Two enthusiastic 5‑star reviews consistently praise both the musical performance and the soundboard quality, indicating an excellent show and recording despite the limited sample size.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the audio as "great" and "so good," with no reported issues; implies a clear, well‑balanced mix.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Not detailed, but overall described as a peak Dead performance.
